rows.grounds: compound denoting the four social classes beginning with brahmins; object of installation
instrumental phrase indicating the prescribed procedure
causative verb enjoining the act of seating or installing

items.question: By what prescribed method should the four social classes beginning with brahmins be installed?
premises: The four social classes beginning with brahmins are the objects to be installed.
A specific method has been previously described in this context.
The ritual act requires causing these classes to be seated or installed.
items.inference: Therefore, one should install the four social classes beginning with brahmins by this prescribed method.
items.plain_english: One should install the four classes, beginning with the brahmins, by this same method.
